name: charge
notes: Base ActionMonster timings; body area depends on enemy. Collision can end attack early.

name: leap
notes: Reference at horizontal speed cap; actual launch depends on target; ends on landing. Source: https://metroid.retropixel.net/games/metroid/manual/metroid1_manual.pdf

name: shoot
notes: Projectile released immediately after wind-up; verify damage hitbox and execution duration. Source: https://deadcells.wiki.gg/wiki/Enemies

name: lob
notes: Scoring reference: 20-unit horizontal target offset, vertical speed -15. Actual horizontal launch follows target. Source: https://deadcells.wiki.gg/wiki/Enemies

name: dive
notes: Base speed; body area depends on enemy. Collision can end attack early.

name: ape_scream
notes: Circle radius 5 units. Scripted opening/hurt wind-ups stay explicit.

name: ape_leap
notes: Reference: 20-unit horizontal travel in 0.75 s. Targeted speed varies. Landing slam is separate.

name: ape_throw
notes: Reference: 20-unit horizontal and zero vertical target offset; aimed ballistic launch varies. Source: https://deadcells.wiki.gg/wiki/Enemies

name: ape_slam
notes: 60 x 8 pixel landing damage rectangle; phase-two hops enlarge it.

name: ape_split
notes: One split stone; two created per impact. Score row represents the pair.

name: ape_log
notes: Starts at rest and accelerates, capped at 17.5 units/s. Initial-speed reference model cannot assign a finite travel-time score; deliberately unscored.

name: dropwing_dive
notes: Drops straight down from its perch, speeding up to Vertical speed; climbs back at 4.5 tiles/s.

name: duskflit_swoop
notes: Flies straight at where the player was; returns to its perch at 3.75 tiles/s.

name: ossling_bone_throw
notes: Lobbed bone; the Armored variant throws two (the second higher). At most 3 bones in the air.

name: hornback_charge
notes: Charges along its floor at a player at its height; stops at walls and ledges.

name: cragjaw_leap
notes: Leaps at the player and slams down (screen shake).

name: murkspore_spread
notes: Three orbs in a fan; only shoots when its last orbs are gone. Keeps about 10 tiles away.
